messages:
maria: Heads-up: Platform wants to retire legacy routing header `X-Rd-Route` in favor of a single canonical `Rd-Route` header. Need SDK owners + console/telemetry to align on rollout, attribution, and customer nudges.
aj: Breaking change risk. Can platform keep server-side shim to accept old header and translate to new value? We need that to avoid immediate quota spikes.
chris: Yes, server will translate for a 90-day window and emit a `route_header_translation` event. Console should record both raw header and translated marker so attribution is clear.
sasha: I'll draft migration snippets for py/ts/go. Proposing SDK flow: opt-in flag -> deprecation minor release that logs and emits telemetry -> hard removal after grace period. Snippet:
```
# python
client = Redwood(api_key=KEY, route_header_mode="v2_optin")
```
leo: devex-bot: py-canary showed a header-parsing edge case when header absent (py-parse-312). Filing ticket.
dan: Telemetry fields suggestion: `route_header_version` (legacy|v1), `route_header_origin` (client|server-translate), `route_header_seen` (bool). Console can use these to show per-tenant %legacy traffic.
emily: Console ask: add a migration tile with %legacy / %translated / %native + time series and a list of top tenants still on legacy so CS can outreach. Backfill job to reconcile past attribution needed too.
aj: I'll add tolerant parsing helper in Go/TS: ParseRouteHeader(h string) (version, origin) and a small deprecation logger. Will include tests and a migration note in changelog.
sasha: Target PRs: py/ts today, go by Friday. Will include docs and code snippets. Also add opt-in toggles for customers who want to delay.
maria: Proposed timeline: announce (week 0), opt-in minor w/warnings (week 1), telemetry + console tile (week 3), server dry-run removal (week 6), hard remove (week 12). Platform will keep translation events for 90 days. Any blockers?
chris: Console ETA: tile + backfill job in 10 business days. Need final telemetry key names ASAP to wire ingestion.
dan: ACK. I'll schedule backfill window and coordinate with infra for retention costs.
emily: ACK. CS migration checklist draft in staging docs.
leo: I'll rerun canaries after PRs and report flakies. devex-bot: reminder set for 4 days to check PRs and canary status.
